wire.legacyReceiver: MQTT 3.1.1 over WSS; original daty-pairing-v1 CONNECT
wire.applicationPrototype: MQTT 5 over WSS; synthetic fixture client only

ingress.sourceAuthority: authenticated socket plus current pairing registry; never client fields or forwarding headers
ingress.sequenceScope: one receiver connection within one gateway boot; starts at 1

invariants.identity: canonical paired MAC receiver_id plus numeric CH; GROUP never routes control
invariants.groupOrder: trusted numeric GROUP ascending, then numeric CH ascending; unknown last; sort before pagination
invariants.newFrequencyUnit: integer kHz; legacy payload freq_mhz remains MHz until explicit versioned conversion
invariants.afUnit: dBFS -40..0; 0 is real zero, null is unknown, absent is unchanged
invariants.brokerReceipt: transport receipt only; neither database commit nor receiver execution
invariants.databaseReceipt: same operation_id, epoch and revision; committed only after server transaction commit
invariants.executionReceipt: matching receiver, session, brand, CH, command_id, command and actual value
invariants.oldEnrollmentIdentityNamespace: preserve original HTTPS server origin | simulated MAC in browser IndexedDB
invariants.publicCaIdentity: preserve current CA; never generate replacement production identity during transport migration

futureRequirements: Server binds reply topic to the actual requesting connection; clientId/replyTo is not authority
Durable idempotency and payload digest before QoS1 command delivery; no ambiguous-command replay
Atomic snapshot watermark plus sequenced deltas; gap triggers snapshot, not guessed state
Database status, file hash, real execution ACK and transport ACK remain distinct
Bootstrap registration connection cannot read business/device topics
No restored operator login, manual access key or authorization UI
File chunks have transfer_id, offset, length, digest and bounded backpressure
Main clock and RTT measurement require separately verified send/receive timing
